fact: In a meta-analysis of 25 studies involving 109,846 patients, GLP-1RA reduced the risk of total MI with a risk ratio (RR) of 0.86 (p < 0.01) and a number needed to benefit (NNTB) of 207 to prevent one event of MI over a follow-up of 3.48 ± 1.51 years.
fact_zh: 在一项纳入25项研究、涉及109,846名患者的荟萃分析中，GLP-1RA将总心肌梗死（MI）的风险降低了风险比（RR）0.86（p < 0.01），需要治疗207人以预防一次MI事件，随访时间为3.48 ± 1.51年。
quote: 109,846 patients from 25 unique studies were included. Over a follow-up duration of 3.48 ± 1.51 (1.55 to 5.47) years, GLP-1RA reduced the risk of total MI (RR: 0.86, p < 0.01), with numbers needed to benefit (NNTB) of 207 to prevent one event of MI.

fact: GLP-1RA reduced cardiovascular mortality with a risk ratio (RR) of 0.87 (p < 0.01) and a number needed to benefit (NNTB) of 170 to prevent one event of cardiovascular mortality over a follow-up of 3.48 ± 1.51 years.
fact_zh: GLP-1RA将心血管死亡的风险比（RR）降低了0.87（p < 0.01），需要治疗170人以预防一次心血管死亡事件，随访时间为3.48 ± 1.51年。
quote: GLP-1RA reduced cardiovascular mortality (RR: 0.87, p < 0.01, NNTB 170), MACE (RR: 0.87, p < 0.01, NNTB 67) and stroke (RR: 0.88, p < 0.01, NNTB 335) compared to placebo.

fact: GLP-1RA reduced the risk of MACE with a risk ratio (RR) of 0.87 (p < 0.01) and a number needed to benefit (NNTB) of 67 to prevent one event of MACE over a follow-up of 3.48 ± 1.51 years.

fact: GLP-1RA reduced the risk of stroke with a risk ratio (RR) of 0.88 (p < 0.01) and a number needed to benefit (NNTB) of 335 to prevent one event of stroke over a follow-up of 3.48 ± 1.51 years.

fact: Higher body mass index was associated with greater MI risk reduction (β: -0.09, p = 0.03) in GLP-1RA users.
fact_zh: 较高的体重指数与GLP-1RA使用者的心肌梗死（MI）风险降低相关（β: -0.09，p = 0.03）。
quote: Higher body mass index was associated with greater MI risk reduction (β: -0.09, p = 0.03) in GLP-1RA users.

fact: In the secondary prevention population, GLP-1RA led to a significant reduction in unstable angina events (RR: 0.88, 95%CI: 0.82 to 0.95, p = 0.03) compared to placebo.
fact_zh: 在二级预防人群中，与安慰剂相比，GLP-1RA显著减少了不稳定型心绞痛事件（RR: 0.88，95%CI: 0.82至0.95，p = 0.03）。

quote: In the secondary prevention population, the use of GLP-1RA led to significant reduction in unstable angina events (RR: 0.88, 95%CI: 0.82 to 0.95, p = 0.03) and coronary revascularization (RR: 0.78, 95%CI: 0.69 to 0.87, p < 0.01) compared to placebo.

quote: GLP-1RA significantly reduced the rates of most outcomes, including total MI (RR: 0.86, 95%I 0.78 to 0.95, p < 0.01), non-fatal MI (RR: 0.87, 95%CI: 0.79 to 0.97, p = 0.02), MACE (RR: 0.87, 95%CI: 0.80 to 0.93, p < 0.01), stroke (RR: 0.88, 95%CI: 0.82 to 0.94, p < 0.01), rates of coronary revascularization (RR: 0.85, 95CI: 0.72 to 0.99, p = 0.04) and cardiovascular mortality (RR: 0.87, 95%CI: 0.82 to 0.93, p < 0.01).
